name: The Effects
label: Dischord
lede: Three DC lifers who had never been in a band together finally were, and made one tightly wound, King Crimson-sized record with J. Robbins in Baltimore.

eras.title: Not a reunion, for once
eras.text: In a scene where most new bands are old bandmates reshuffled, the Effects pitched themselves as the opposite. Devin Ocampo, Matt Dowling and David Rich had circled each other for years and were finally free at the same time.

years.h: Ocampo, Dowling and Rich start the Effects
years.p: [[Devin Ocampo|10bc183b-b6a8-4769-9e7a-0637d0f8a7a8]] sings and plays guitar, Matt Dowling plays bass and keys, David Rich drums. The three had talked about a band for years; in January 2014 all of them finally had room.
years.xp:
Devin Ocampo came in with the longest résumé: [[Smart Went Crazy|d9c78028-a30b-470b-b964-2f85cab51cc2]], [[Faraquet|e866e006-4c80-4753-b53f-1bc5d88ccddd]], [[Medications|c545a7bf-c8d7-4368-8009-22e19d8911ce]] and [[Deathfix|db0e5c06-c091-46d4-bd42-5ba2ee299123]], plus stints backing [[Mary Timony|d9c8dc3c-15b8-40d5-8153-ae9214aeef55]], [[J. Robbins|3babd931-a940-43a8-b629-d7aed5b821d9]] and [[Beauty Pill|976b28a1-dd68-4c43-ba08-ba15b58963b2]], often as the drummer. Matt Dowling had co-led [[Deleted Scenes|ed530932-648a-4e28-8bba-507e02986a60]]; David Rich had played in the instrumental band Buildings. Both of their earlier bands were on the now-defunct Sockets label.

The Effects' own framing, on their Dischord page: this was a fresh lineup, not old friends and former bandmates recombined.

years.h: The Effects' first single: Blister b/w Old Soul
years.p: Self-released, and the Effects' first recording out the door.

years.h: The Effects' Closer b/w Eyes to the Light
years.p: The Effects' second self-released 2014 single. Its B-side lends its name to the band's 2017 album, though the song itself isn't on it.

eras.title: Two more singles, then Magpie Cage
eras.text: The Effects built their name the slow way, one self-released two-song single at a time. Then they took nine songs up I-95 to J. Robbins' Magpie Cage studio in Baltimore.

years.h: The Effects' 2015 singles: Essentially Broken and Fix As The Reason
years.p: Two more self-released singles from the Effects: Essentially Broken b/w The Clarity Of Open Spaces, and Fix As The Reason b/w Close The Gap.

years.h: The Effects record with J. Robbins in Baltimore
years.p: The Effects record and mix nine songs with [[J. Robbins|3babd931-a940-43a8-b629-d7aed5b821d9]] of [[Jawbox|016fba14-1fc6-4986-86c2-2113ec9b28de]] at his Magpie Cage studio in Baltimore. Devin Ocampo had worked with Robbins before; this time Robbins is behind the board.

eras.title: Eyes to the Light
eras.text: Three years in, the Effects landed on Dischord with a debut, Eyes to the Light, that critics heard as DC post-hardcore at its most technical. Reviewers reached for prog, not punk, as the reference point.

q: The 'we got chops' end of post-hardcore.
years.src: Dischord · Bandcamp Daily · Washington City Paper · Wikipedia
years.p: The Effects' debut: nine songs on LP, CD and digital, from New Isolation to the six-and-a-half-minute closer Moving On.
years.xp:
Dischord announced the album on August 9, with pre-orders on Dischord and Bandcamp and East Coast and Midwest dates promised for the fall.

Bandcamp Daily made it Album of the Day on October 19. Joe Gross heard complex, almost proggy trio workouts and King Crimson in the motion, and flagged the vocal hook on Anchors Aweigh and the chugging back half of Low Lier.

Washington City Paper's headline said the Effects put the power in power trio; Post-Trash reviewed it and ran a long interview with Devin Ocampo. Wikipedia sums up the critical take as an updated take on the D.C. sound.

years.h: The Effects tour Eyes to the Light
years.p: The Effects take Eyes to the Light out on dates through the East Coast and the Midwest.

eras.title: Ocampo plays with Watt
eras.text: Dischord still lists the Effects as active, but by 2019 Devin Ocampo was being billed elsewhere as formerly of the band. His next project put him on stage with Minutemen bassist Mike Watt.

years.h: Devin Ocampo and Mike Watt at the Black Cat's 25th
years.p: Devin Ocampo, Renata Ocampo and [[Mike Watt|568203ae-c27b-4990-8997-09c0d5c0de77]] play together for the first time at the Black Cat's 25th anniversary show in DC.

years.h: "Anchors Aweigh" live at Comet Ping Pong, January 20, 2018
yt: "Anchors Aweigh" live at Comet Ping Pong, January 20, 2018

years.h: Ocampo, Ocampo + Watt: Apparatus b/w Better Than A Dirtnap
years.p: The single by Devin Ocampo, Renata Ocampo and Mike Watt comes out on Org Music, whose notes describe Devin Ocampo as formerly of the Effects.
